name: Fushimi Nagisa
source:
Class: Camellia, Second Year

A tomboyish girl who's friends with [url=/c97600]Mikoto[/url]. She doesn't like to hang around in big groups, making her and Mikoto a well-matched pair. She's not much of a gossip herself, but due to working on the school newspaper, all kinds of rumors find their way to her ears. Still, she hates when people assume she knows everything that's going on.
